messages:
Priya: Heads up — dashboard shows p95 > p99 for /v1/generate (us-west). Screenshot attached :confused:
Daniel: Wait what, p95 higher than p99? that shouldn't be possible unless aggregation is wrong :eyes:
Marco: I saw a couple spikes on worker-12 around 12:03 but even then p99 should dominate. can you paste the numbers?
Priya: p50=45ms, p95=420ms, p99=380ms. On the per-worker view many nodes show p95 around 400 and p99 around 380.
Leah: That pattern screams "we averaged per-worker percentiles" — averaging percentiles across shards can invert ordering. You need to recompute from raw samples or merge sketches.
Maria: Yep. We currently store minute-level percentiles emitted by each shard and then take the mean in the dashboard pipeline. That was a compromise to save storage.
Julia: TL;DR: per-shard summary -> mean across shards is not an order-preserving estimator for percentiles. Use t-digest/HdrHistogram merge or compute from histogram buckets globally.
Priya: Ok, makes sense. Is there a quick fix for the UI so customers don't see contradictory percentiles?
Daniel: Short-term: mask percentiles when the aggregation mode is "per-shard-avg" and show a tooltip: "Percentiles are from averaged per-shard summaries; for accurate global percentiles enable merged-sketch telemetry."
Marco: Medium-term: change telemetry pipeline to emit a merged t-digest per minute. Implementation idea: each serving pod exports a compact t-digest; ingestion merges them into one per endpoint+region.
Leah: We also need to consider rollout UX — this will change cardinality of telemetry keys. Add a migration plan: backfill last 7d with merged sketches for high-volume endpoints only.
Priya: Is there a storage/cost estimate for keeping t-digests per minute per endpoint?
Marco: Rough calc: 1000 endpoints * 1440 minutes * 200 bytes ~ 288MB/day. For top 200 endpoints it's trivial.
Maria: Good point about endpoints: we should gate on endpoint tier (internal vs public) and sampling rate. Also update quota docs: percentiles accuracy depends on telemetry method.
Daniel: Action items:
- Marco: prototype ingestion merge + export endpoint to test cluster (job: merge-tdigest-ep).
- Julia: write short explainer for UI team about "aggregation mode" and suggested tooltip text.
- Leah: update rollout checklist to include telemetry key-sketch migration strategy.
- Priya: update dashboard to hide conflicting percentiles until we switch aggregation.
Priya: I'll open the tickets. tagging ops-bot for deploy window planning @ops-bot
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window request created: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC (ticket #INF-4123) :white_check_mark:
Marco: For the prototype, here's the pseudo-query for validating correctness:
```sql
-- recompute global percentiles from merged histograms
SELECT tdigest_percentile(merged_tdigest, 0.95) as p95,
       tdigest_percentile(merged_tdigest, 0.99) as p99
FROM telemetry_merged
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND region = 'us-west' AND ts BETWEEN X AND Y;
```
Julia: Also add a UI flag: "percentile_method: [per-shard-avg, merged-sketch]" so users can opt-in to the strict method while we roll it out.
Leah: We'll need a short changelog entry and a note in the console: "percentile accuracy improved; may cause previous p95/p99 to adjust". communicate to customers via #announcements and docs.
Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll link tickets once created. low-priority followup: consider showing p90 too, it's often more stable for latency SLOs. :+1:
Daniel: +1 on p90. Also let's add a unit test that simulates two shards with different latency distributions demonstrating the inversion problem.
Marco: I'll add that to the prototype repo. End of thread.
